verdict.rationale: Omarchy's docs say that "Everything in Omarchy happens via the keyboard — EVERYTHING!". They document a `Super + Space` app launcher, a `Super + Alt + Space` Omarchy Menu, and a `Super + K` keybinding overview. Window-management hotkeys (tiling/floating, layout toggle) and dedicated hotkeys for the terminal, browser, clipboard, reminders and OCR are also documented. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of keyboard-only operation, and a fuller documented list of window focus/move/workspace bindings.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can operate the entire system using only the keyboard via hotkeys and a launcher

citations.quote: Everything in Omarchy happens via the keyboard — EVERYTHING!
you can hit `Super + Space` to reveal the application launcher and `Super + Alt + Space` to open the Omarchy Menu.
You can see all the main keyboard bindings with `Super + K`.
`Super + T` Toggle window between tiling/floating ... `Super + L` Toggle between dwindle and scrolling layout
You start the terminal with `Super + Return` and a browser with `Super + Shift + Return`.
